stages.on_a_card_about_b: A target Corvus ambushes with Vision in Edinburgh.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Black Order warrior who ambushes Wanda and Vision, stabbing Vision.

question: When Wanda is overpowering Thanos, he orders Corvus to have the Sanctuary II fire on the field; Corvus protests, then calls the strike that blows Wanda aside. Is that one acting against the other?

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins serves on the S.H.I.E.L.D. STRIKE team that works under Steve Rogers. When HYDRA is exposed, Rollins joins the elevator ambush on Steve and later holds a rifle to his head after his capture.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rollins's STRIKE commander, whom he ambushes once HYDRA is exposed.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A STRIKE agent under Steve who turns out to be HYDRA and ambushes him.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Steve Rogers, back in 2012 from the future, steps into an elevator with Rollins and his STRIKE agents and whispers "Hail Hydra" to trick them into handing over Loki's scepter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Captain America from the future, who tricks Rollins out of the scepter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Steve tricks out of the scepter in 2012 with a whispered "Hail Hydra."

their_evidence: 2012 time heist: Rollins and STRIKE take the Scepter at Stark Tower; Steve intercepts them in the elevator and, feigning Hydra affiliation, gets them to hand it over.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes joins the new Avengers under Steve Rogers after Sokovia.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's leader on the new Avengers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new Avenger who joins under Steve after Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Rhodey signs the Sokovia Accords and fights Steve's side at the Leipzig airport.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A rival over the Accords, whose side Rhodes fights at Leipzig.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A rival who signs the Accords and fights Steve's side at Leipzig.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos' forces come for Vision, Rhodey defies the Accords and fights beside Steve again to defend Wakanda.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An ally again, whom Rhodes fights beside to defend Wakanda.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An ally again, who defies the Accords to defend Wakanda with Steve.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: After the Snap, Rhodey and Steve are among the surviving Avengers at the compound. Rhodey joins the plan to bring back the Infinity Stones through time and fights beside Steve against the 2014 Thanos.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow surviving Avenger, beside whom Rhodes joins the time heist.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow surviving Avenger who joins the time heist beside Steve.

their_evidence: Rhodes and Rogers reunite with Stark as the remaining Avengers, plan the Time Heist together (Rhodes goes to 2014 Morag with Nebula), and both fight in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Groot travels with Thor and Rocket to Nidavellir and gives up part of his arm to make the handle of Thor's new axe, Stormbreaker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: God Groot travels with, giving part of his arm for Stormbreaker.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who gives part of his arm to make the handle of Thor's Stormbreaker.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Thor leaves Earth with Groot and the Guardians. When Thor and Quill argue over who leads, Groot is all for settling it with knives, and Thor rules out any knifing.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: God who joins Groot and the Guardians as they leave Earth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian Thor leaves Earth with, keen to settle the leadership spat with knives.

their_evidence: Closing Benatar scene: Thor joins the Guardians; quote 'I am Groot.' / 'Not necessary!' / 'There shall be no knifing one another.' (Groot, Star-Lord, Thor).

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and Rocket first try to cash in on the bounty on Peter Quill, then team up with him as founding Guardians. Groot sacrifices himself to save the team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bounty turned fellow founding Guardian, whom Groot gives his life to save.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Bounty hunter turned founding Guardian, who sacrifices himself for the team.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Groot and Peter Quill, back from the Snap, set off together with the Guardians. When Quill and Thor argue over who leads, Groot is ready for a knife fight, and Quill says it's not necessary.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow Guardian who sets off with Groot, and turns down a knife fight.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow Guardian, all for settling Quill's leadership spat with Thor by knives.

their_evidence: Closing Benatar scene: Groot agrees to Quill and Thor fighting with knives; Quill answers 'Not necessary!'.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula tricks the young Groot into freeing her from her restraints, then joins Taserface's mutiny. She later comes around and fights alongside Groot against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Captive who tricks Groot into freeing her, then fights beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Nebula tricks into freeing her, then fights beside against Ego.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Nebula rejoins the Guardians aboard the Benatar with Groot. When Quill and Thor argue over who leads, she suggests they fight for it and Groot wants knives.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow Guardian who sets off into space with Groot after the battle.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian she sets off into space with after the battle.

their_evidence: Nebula rejoins the Guardians in the Benatar with Rocket, Drax, Mantis, Groot and Quill; she suggests Thor and Quill fight for leadership, and Groot chimes in for knives.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and he and Pepper Potts are close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend, and Tony's assistant.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend, and Tony's bodyguard and driver.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Happy Hogan watches Tony's last message with Pepper Potts and her daughter at the lake house, then stays with Morgan after the funeral and promises her cheeseburgers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's widow, whose daughter Happy looks after at the funeral.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Old friend who watches Tony's last message with Pepper and looks after Morgan.

their_evidence: Tony Stark's funeral: Hogan, along with Pepper Potts, Morgan and others, watches Tony's recording at the Stark Eco-Compound; afterwards he sits with Morgan and promises her cheeseburgers.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell serves alongside Natasha at S.H.I.E.L.D. Once she and Steve learn he is Hydra, they abduct him and force him to reveal the truth about Project Insight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow agent who abducts Sitwell to learn about Insight.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow agent, until Natasha finds he is HYDRA and abducts him.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: After the Battle of New York, Natasha hands Loki's scepter to Sitwell in Stark Tower, not knowing he means to deliver it to HYDRA.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger who hands Sitwell Loki's scepter in Stark Tower.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Natasha unknowingly hands Loki's scepter to.

their_evidence: 2012 New York heist: Sitwell and STRIKE arrive at Stark Tower and collect the scepter from Natasha ('We can take that off your hands.' 'By all means.'), on Pierce's orders to take it to HYDRA.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell is a S.H.I.E.L.D. officer among the hostages Steve Rogers rescues from the Lemurian Star. Once Steve learns Sitwell is HYDRA, he and Natasha force him to reveal Project Insight's targets.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A colleague who uncovers Sitwell's HYDRA ties and forces out Insight's targets.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. officer Steve rescues from the Lemurian Star, who turns out to be HYDRA.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Steve stops Sitwell in a Stark Tower elevator and whispers "Hail Hydra" to him, tricking him into handing over Loki's scepter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tricks Sitwell out of Loki's scepter with a whispered "Hail Hydra."
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Steve tricks into handing over Loki's scepter.

their_evidence: 2012 New York heist: Steve approaches Sitwell and Rumlow in the elevator, Sitwell wants to call Fury, Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra' and Sitwell gives him the scepter.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Miek is Korg's best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and they escape with Thor together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and a fellow escapee.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and a fellow escapee.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Korg and Miek live with Thor in New Asgard, where Miek watches Korg play video games, and they fight side by side against Thanos's army.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A housemate at Thor's in New Asgard, and a partner in the final battle.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A housemate at Thor's in New Asgard, and a partner in the final battle.

their_evidence: Thor introduces 'my friends, Miek, Korg' to Hulk in his New Asgard house; Miek watches Korg play video games for five years; Miek fights alongside Korg in the Battle of Earth.
